Jacket size and optional feedback
1. Your jacket

2. Your experience · optional

Thinking about your dealings with Hybrid-Ag this year, how would you rate each area? 1 = Very poor. 10 = Excellent. You can skip any question. Choose N/A if an area isn't relevant or you can't rate it yet. If you haven't raised a problem, choose N/A for the last question.

You can also tell us what is working well, or anything else we should know.
